verification.rule: compose(segment parts, point) against render_noise(edit_payload(base, point)) at the render seed, first segment; idx 0 is the base point, the rest uniform draws

stage2.rule: per parameter [min - 0.1 R, max + 0.1 R] of the stage-1 best 8 feasible points by mean PIT (feasible: beats nv3r4's tuning-set mean PIT and mean LTAS), R the stage-1 range, clipped to the stage-1 box; with no feasible point the best by mean PIT alone
